title: Conormal exterior module
statement: For a commutative ring A, ideal I and natural number n, conormalExteriorModule A I n is the A-module obtained by restricting scalars on the nth exterior power over A/I of the cotangent module I/I². The ambient module and quotient conventions are those of [def-weil-pbc-module-chain-complex-homology].

proof.text: Use the existing upstream conormalExteriorModule: form the nth exterior power of Ideal.Cotangent over A/I and restrict scalars along A to A/I. This is definitionally the original construction, including the bundled A-module structure. The unused Sheaf duplicate is withdrawn.
